department: Department of Astronomy (Field of Astronomy and Space Sciences)

deadline.value: All materials, including letters and test scores, must reach Cornell by December 1; no spring admission.
deadline.quote: All application materials must be received by Cornell no later than December 1st.

gre_general.value: GRE General scores are not accepted.
gre_general.quote: The General and Physics GRE exams are not required for admission, nor will scores be accepted as part of the admissions process.

gre_subject.value: Physics GRE scores are not accepted.
gre_subject.quote: The General and Physics GRE exams are not required for admission, nor will scores be accepted as part of the admissions process.

english_waiver.value: The department grants an automatic exemption after two or more years of English-taught study in the last five years in a country whose primary language is English; Graduate School standing exemptions also apply.
english_waiver.quote: An applicant will automatically be granted a TOEFL exemption if he or she studied for two or more years (in the last five years) in a country where the primary language is English and the instruction was in English.

supervisor.value: Not stated on the official pages fetched.

funding.value: The field offers funding to all admitted PhD students.
funding.quote: In addition to offering generous funding to all admitted PhD students, we encourage applicants who are experiencing financial hardships to seek an application fee waiver

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree or international equivalent is required.
entry_route.quote: a Bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) from an academic institution of recognized standing.

notes: The page also states an outdated TOEFL minimum of 600 paper-based / 250 computer-based; the Graduate School iBT section minimums apply.
